subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: North the Cold Unknown
description: A micro-lesson that makes North the Cold Unknown usable.

hook.text: In many traditions, evil lives in the north. Satan enters from the north in medieval art. Cold equals danger.

buildup.text: For Mediterranean cultures, the north was a barren, dark place of barbarians—Scythians, Goths, Vikings.

discovery.text: But Norse myths saw north as home. The fearful direction shifts depending on where you stand.

twist.text: Santa Claus lives at the North Pole. A fearful direction became a magical one. Culture can reverse any symbol.

climax.text: North represents the edge of knowledge. It's the direction of cold, darkness, and whatever lies beyond the map.

punchline.text: Point north. That's where fear lives.

quiz.question: Why did Mediterranean cultures associate the north with evil?
options: It was cold, dark, and home to threatening peoples
